notes: In-Vault editor: tap a Pokémon in the Vault → Edit to change it right there — shininess (with legal, PID-correlated IVs), IVs/EVs, moves, nature, level, species, nickname, OT and more — no game or save file needed. Edits re-encode the stored Pokémon (self-checksumming), so cloning it into a game stays legal and backup-first.
